requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: Upgrades sit behind a 4-of-7 Squads v3 multisig, and Squads v3 has no delay field, so an approved upgrade can land with no notice. A swap router holds no deposits between transactions, which limits what an upgrade could reach.
narrative.tag: same authority upgrades 22 other ProgramData accounts
narrative.detail: The upgrade authority is a PDA, resolved to authority index 1 of a Squads v3 multisig and re-derived offline on every run. All 7 members are plain on-curve keys. The same PDA is the upgrade authority of 22 other ProgramData accounts (a blast-radius note, not scored), and the same multisig is also the admin of Jupiter Perpetual Exchange. Other paths are bounded: a hardcoded close_token operator only reaches the program's own token accounts, and claim sweeps to a fixed wallet. The on-chain IDL has no oracle account, so the oracle sub-score is not applicable.

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
main_gap.reason: Changes can apply with no waiting time

independent_read.path: program -> ProgramData 4Ec7Zx… -> upgrade authority (a program-derived address, off the curve: a Squads vault or a protocol PDA, no key can sign for it directly)
independent_read.posture: admin: a program-derived address (not a Squads v4 vault); delay: unknown
